title: echium angustifolium var. onosmoides
intro: Echium angustifolium var. onosmoides, commonly known as Onosma, is a plant species within the borage family (Boraginaceae). This plant has been traditionally used for its medicinal properties, providing several health benefits, including anti-inflammatory and antioxidant effects, which may aid in the management of conditions such as arthritis and oxidative stress. The therapeutic actions of Onosma include anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antiviral activities, which can contribute to its potential use in treating various health issues. Bioactive constituents of Onosma include alkaloids, flavonoids, and phenolic compounds, which are responsible for its medicinal properties and health benefits.
